concepts.gloss_en: Kavod — glory/honor (of God); divine honor whose blemishing and revelation govern the mentalities of the Diaspora

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are הַכָּבוֹד in the same paragraph of lm2:71, one referring to the blemishing of honor (פְּגַם הַכָּבוֹד) and one to its revelation (הִתְגַּלּוּת הַכָּבוֹד) — clearly the same word and the same concept of divine glory. No homograph or article-driven split is at play. Straightforward single-concept grouping.
